SELECT
    DATE(event_time) as event_date,
    endpoint_name,
    destination_name,
    destination_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-')) AS destination_model,
    destination_type,
    requester,
    requester_type,
    api_type,
    workspace_id,
    CASE :param_group_key
      WHEN 'Endpoint' THEN CAST(endpoint_name AS STRING)
      WHEN 'Destination Type' THEN CAST(destination_type AS STRING)
      WHEN 'Model' THEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-'))
      WHEN 'User' THEN CAST(requester AS STRING)
      WHEN 'Workspace ID' THEN CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)
    END AS group_by_key,
    status_code,
    response_content_type,
    -- Fallback occurred: 1 if num_attempts > 1 else 0
    CASE
      WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as fallback_occurred,
    -- Fallback Reason
    CASE
      WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 THEN
  routing_information.attempts[0].status_code
      ELSE NULL
    END AS fallback_reason_status_code,
    ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
      THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * 100.0 / COUNT(*))
      ELSE 0
    END,
    2
  ) as fallback_rate_pct,
  -- Fallback success/failure status
  CASE
    WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 AND status_code < 400 THEN 'SUCCESS'
    WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 AND status_code >= 400 THEN 'FAIL'
    ELSE NULL
  END as fallback_status,
    -- Request counts
    COUNT(*) as request_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) as unique_request_count,
    -- Error count 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error_count,
    -- Token metrics
    SUM(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
    SUM(COALESCE(token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) as
  cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(COALESCE(token_details.output_reasoning_tokens, 0)) as
  output_reasoning_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) / 1440.0 as tokens_per_minute,
    -- Latency metrics
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.5) as p50_latency_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.90) as p90_latency_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95_latency_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99_latency_ms,
    AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms,
    MIN(latency_ms) as min_latency_ms,
    MAX(latency_ms) as max_latency_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0 as median_latency_s,
    -- TTFB metrics
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.5) as p50_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.90) as p90_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.95) as p95_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.99) as p99_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    AVG(time_to_first_byte_ms) as avg_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    MIN(time_to_first_byte_ms) as min_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    MAX(time_to_first_byte_ms) as max_time_to_first_byte_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0 as
  median_time_to_first_byte_s,
    -- Cache hit ratio
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(input_tokens) > 0 THEN
        ROUND(
          (SUM(COALESCE(token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) * 100.0 /
  SUM(input_tokens)),
          2
        )
      ELSE 0
    END as cache_hit_ratio_pct
  FROM
    `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
  WHERE
    event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND DATE_ADD(:date_range.max, 1)
    AND destination_model IS NOT NULL
    AND (invocation_metadata.source != 'AI_QUERY' OR invocation_metadata.source IS NULL)
    AND (service_type != 'MCP_SERVICE' OR service_type IS NULL)
    AND (
      :param_group_values IS NULL
      OR SIZE(:param_group_values) = 0
      OR array_contains(
        :param_group_values,
        CASE :param_group_key
          WHEN 'Endpoint' THEN CAST(endpoint_name AS STRING)
          WHEN 'Destination Type' THEN CAST(destination_type AS STRING)
          WHEN 'Model' THEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-'))
          WHEN 'User' THEN CAST(requester AS STRING)
          WHEN 'Workspace ID' THEN CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)
        END
      )
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE(event_time),
    endpoint_name,
    destination_name,
    destination_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-')),
    destination_type,
    requester,
    requester_type,
    api_type,
    workspace_id,
    CASE :param_group_key
      WHEN 'Endpoint' THEN CAST(endpoint_name AS STRING)
      WHEN 'Destination Type' THEN CAST(destination_type AS STRING)
      WHEN 'Model' THEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-'))
      WHEN 'User' THEN CAST(requester AS STRING)
    END,
    status_code,
    response_content_type,
    CASE WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 THEN routing_information.attempts[0].status_code ELSE NULL END,
    CASE 
      WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 AND status_code < 400 THEN 'SUCCESS'
      WHEN SIZE(routing_information.attempts) > 1 AND status_code >= 400 THEN 'FAIL'
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ORDER BY
    total_tokens DESC

-- temp view as a fallback if table_name is not provided --
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW `table_name` AS
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<
      time_unix_nano: BIGINT,
      attributes: STRUCT<type: STRING>,
      value: DOUBLE
    >) AS sum,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS name
  WHERE 1 = 0;

  WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT
      to_timestamp(sum.time_unix_nano / 1e9) AS ts,
      name,
      sum.attributes.type AS attribute_type,
      sum.value AS value
    FROM IDENTIFIER(:table_name)
    WHERE to_timestamp(sum.time_unix_nano / 1e9) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND DATE_ADD(:date_range.max, 1)
  )
  SELECT
    ts,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND attribute_type = 'added' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS lines_added,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND attribute_type = 'removed' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS lines_removed,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.session.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS sessions_started,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.pull_request.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS pull_requests_created,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.commit.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS commits_created,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.active_time.total' THEN value/60
          ELSE 0
        END) AS active_time_total
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY ts
  ORDER BY ts

-- Combined PPT and EM Pricing
--
-- Parameters:
-- :date_range (DATE_RANGE)
-- :workspace_id (ARRAY)
-- :param_group_key (STRING)
-- :param_time_key (STRING) - Day, Week, or Month

WITH ppt_billing AS (
  SELECT
    usage_date AS event_date,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_id AS destination_name,
    workspace_id,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_model AS model_name,
    CAST(identity_metadata.run_as AS STRING) AS requester,
    sku_name,
    usage_type,
    SUM(usage_quantity) AS total_dbu
  FROM system.billing.usage
  WHERE billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'
    AND (:param_group_key = 'Governed vs Ungoverned' OR usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_name IS NOT NULL)
    AND usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min
      AND DATE_ADD(:date_range.max, 1)
    AND (
      :workspace_id IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)
    )
  GROUP BY
    usage_date,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_name,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_id,
    workspace_id,
    usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_model,
    identity_metadata.run_as,
    sku_name,
    usage_type
),

prices AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      price_end_time,
      DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
    ) AS coalesced_price_end_time,
    *
  FROM system.billing.list_prices
  WHERE currency_code = 'USD'
),

ppt_data AS (
  SELECT
    b.event_date,
    b.endpoint_name,
    b.destination_name,
    b.workspace_id,
    'Databricks-Hosted Foundation Model' AS destination_type,
    LOWER(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(b.model_name, '[ .]+', '-')
    ) AS destination_model,
    b.requester,
    b.total_dbu,
    CAST(
      COALESCE(
        b.total_dbu * p.pricing.effective_list.default,
        0
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)
    ) AS sum_cost_usd,
    b.usage_type,
    CASE WHEN b.endpoint_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Governed' ELSE 'Ungoverned' END AS governance
  FROM ppt_billing b
  LEFT JOIN prices p
    ON b.sku_name = p.sku_name
    AND p.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND b.event_date >= p.price_start_time
    AND b.event_date < p.coalesced_price_end_time
),

em_data AS (
  SELECT
    usage_date AS event_date,
    usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    usage_metadata.destination_name AS destination_name,
    workspace_id,
    'External Foundation Model' AS destination_type,
    LOWER(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(usage_metadata.model, '[ .]+', '-')
    ) AS destination_model,
    CAST(identity_metadata.run_as AS STRING) AS requester,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_dbu,
    CAST(SUM(usage_quantity) AS DECIMAL(38,18))
      AS sum_cost_usd,
    'EXTERNAL' AS usage_type,
    'Governed' AS governance
  FROM system.ai_gateway.external_model_spend
  WHERE usage_date BETWEEN :date_range.min
    AND DATE_ADD(:date_range.max, 1)
    AND (
      :workspace_id IS NULL
      OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)
    )
  GROUP BY
    usage_date,
    usage_metadata.endpoint_name,
    usage_metadata.destination_name,
    workspace_id,
    usage_metadata.model,
    identity_metadata.run_as
),

combined_data AS (
  SELECT * FROM ppt_data
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM em_data
),

data_with_grouping AS (
  SELECT
    CASE :param_time_key
      WHEN 'Week'
        THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) AS DATE)
      WHEN 'Month'
        THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) AS DATE)
      ELSE event_date
    END AS time_period,
    workspace_id,
    CASE :param_group_key
      WHEN 'Destination Type'
        THEN COALESCE(destination_type, 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'Usage Type'
        THEN COALESCE(usage_type, 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'Model'
        THEN COALESCE(destination_model, 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'User'
        THEN COALESCE(requester, 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'Endpoint'
        THEN COALESCE(endpoint_name, 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'Workspace ID'
        THEN COALESCE(CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), 'Unknown')
      WHEN 'Governed vs Ungoverned'
        THEN COALESCE(governance, 'Unknown')
      ELSE COALESCE(destination_type, 'Unknown')
    END AS group_key,
    sum_cost_usd
  FROM combined_data
)

SELECT
  time_period,
  workspace_id,
  group_key,
  CAST(SUM(sum_cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS sum_cost_usd
FROM data_with_grouping
GROUP BY
  time_period,
  workspace_id,
  group_key
ORDER BY
  time_period DESC,
  sum_cost_usd DESC;

data_with_time_buckets as ( select date_trunc('MONTH', event_date) as usage_month, date_trunc('WEEK', event_date) as usage_week, event_date as usage_date, * from combined_data where event_date between     WHERE u.destination_type = 'PAY_PER_TOKEN_FOUNDATION_MODEL'

      u.requester,

        CASE

          ELSE 0
        END

      CAST(SUM(

          - COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)
          - COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, 0)

        ) / 1000000.0 * r.input_rate
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_input_dbu,
      CAST(SUM(
        COALESCE(u.output_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0 * r.output_rate
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_output_dbu,
      CAST(SUM(
        COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0
          * COALESCE(r.cache_creation_rate, 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_cache_creation_dbu,
      CAST(SUM(
        COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0
          * COALESCE(r.cache_read_rate, 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_cache_read_dbu,
      CAST(SUM(
        (
          COALESCE(u.input_tokens, 0)
          - COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)
          - COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, 0)
        ) / 1000000.0 * r.input_rate
        + COALESCE(u.output_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0 * r.output_rate
        + COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0
            * COALESCE(r.cache_creation_rate, 0)
        + COALESCE(u.token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0) / 1000000.0
            * COALESCE(r.cache_read_rate, 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38,18)) AS total_dbu
    FROM normalized_usage u
    JOIN token_rates r
      ON u.model_key = r.model_key
      AND r.is_long_context = CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM model_thresholds th
          WHERE u.model_key = th.model_key
            AND COALESCE(u.input_tokens, 0) > th.threshold
        ) THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE

      u.endpoint_name,
      u.destination_id,
      u.workspace_id,

        TRIM(usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_model),
        '[ ._]+',
        '-'
      )) AS model_key,
      sku_name,
      usage_unit
    FROM system.billing.usage
    WHERE billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'
      AND usage_type = 'TOKEN'
      AND usage_unit = 'DBU'
      AND usage_date >= :date_range.min
      AND usage_date < DATE_ADD(:date_range.max, 1)
      AND (
        :workspace_id IS NULL
        OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)
      )
      AND usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_name IS NOT NULL
      AND usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_model IS NOT NULL
  ),

  prices AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(price_end_time, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, 1)) AS coalesced_price_end_time,
      *
    FROM system.billing.list_prices
    WHERE currency_code = 'USD'
  )

  SELECT
    a.date,

    a.destination_id,
    a.workspace_id,
    a.requester,

    a.model_name,
    a.request_count,
    a.total_input_tokens + a.total_output_tokens AS total_tokens,
    a.total_input_tokens,

      destination_type,

      ) AS daily_total_cost_usd
    FROM billing_usage b
    LEFT JOIN prices p

      AND p.usage_unit = 'DBU'
      AND b.date >= p.price_start_time

    GROUP BY
      b.date,
      b.model,
      b.user_id,
      b.endpoint,

      b.usage_type,

  ),

      usage_date AS date,

      LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(

      usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint,

  PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.50) / 1000.0 AS p50_latency_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.90) / 1000.0 AS p90_latency_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_latency_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.99) / 1000.0 AS p99_latency_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.50) / 1000.0 AS p50_time_to_first_byte_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.90) / 1000.0 AS p90_time_to_first_byte_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_time_to_first_byte_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(time_to_first_byte_ms, 0.99) / 1000.0 AS p99_time_to_first_byte_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(
    CASE WHEN response_content_type IN ('text/event-stream', 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8')
      THEN time_to_first_byte_ms END,
    0.90
  ) / 1000.0 AS p90_streaming_time_to_first_byte_s,
  PERCENTILE_APPROX(
    CASE WHEN response_content_type IN ('text/event-stream', 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8')
      AND output_tokens > 0
      AND (latency_ms - time_to_first_byte_ms) > 0
      THEN output_tokens / ((latency_ms - time_to_first_byte_ms) / 1000.0) END,
    0.50
  ) AS p50_output_tokens_per_sec,
  COALESCE(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    0.0
  ) AS error_rate_pct
FROM system.ai_gateway.usage

    AND DATE_ADD(CAST(:date_range.max AS DATE), 1)
    AND destination_model IS NOT NULL

    AND (service_type != 'MCP_SERVICE' OR service_type IS NULL)
    AND (
      :param_group_values IS NULL
      OR SIZE(:param_group_values) = 0
      OR array_contains(
        :param_group_values,
        CASE :param_group_key
          WHEN 'Endpoint' THEN CAST(endpoint_name AS STRING)

display_days AS (

## What's New in v0.7

 

**Filtering and Grouping** * **Simplified filtering**: Use Filter Key and Filter Value to choose a dimension and filter Overview, Performance, and Usage without managing multiple separate controls. **Cost Analysis** * **Flexible cost grouping**: Group and filter costs by endpoint, model, user, workspace, destination type, usage type, or governed status, with day, week, or month aggregation. * Endpoint and request tags provide cost breakdowns across selected workspaces, with the most relevant tag key selected by default. **Performance** * Latency and time-to-first-byte trends now use a seven-day rolling P90, making performance changes easier to identify. * A new P50 Output speed (tokens/sec) tile shows median output generation speed for streaming responses, excluding time-to-first-byte.

## Data sources
The dashboard is built on top of the following system tables: - [system.ai\_gateway.usage](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/ai-gateway/usage-tracking-beta) - [system.billing.usage](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/billing) - [system.billing.list\_prices](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/pricing) - [system.access.audit](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/system-tables/audit-logs) - [system.ai\_gateway.external\_model\_spend](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/ai-gateway/cost-observability#external-models)

## AI Gateway Usage Dashboard

Version: v0.7

This dashboard provides comprehensive visibility into your AI Gateway usage, including request volumes, token consumption, latency performance, cost analysis and coding agent activity.

###  Tabs

- **Overview: ** Request counts, token usage, error rates, and top users at a glance
- **Performance**: Latency percentiles (P50/P90/P95/P99) and time-to-first-byte metrics
- **Usage**: Token usage trends over time by endpoints, models and users
- **Coding Agents**: Usage breakdown by coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Pi, and OpenCode)
- **MCPs**: UC MCP service request volumes, latency, error rates, and top services, tools, and users
- **UC Connections**: External MCP connection request volumes, top users, and error rates
- **Cost Analysis**: Cost over time with period-by-period analysis and attribution by endpoints, users, models, endpoint tags and request tags.
